question: Which mantra is assigned to protect the speaker in the southern direction?
premises: A ten-syllabled mantra beginning with hrīṃ-śrīṃ is named
Constant protection of the speaker is requested
inference: The ten-syllabled hrīṃ-śrīṃ mantra always protects the speaker in the south.
plain_english: May the ten-syllabled mantra with hrīṃ and śrīṃ always protect me in the south.
